title: Nova Agent Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Nova coding agent (v2). Supports layered merging: global (~/.config/nova/config.json) → project (.nova/config.json) → environment variables. JSON keys are camelCase; legacy snake_case keys are accepted for backward compatibility.

version.description: Semantic version of the configuration schema instance.

defaultModel.description: Primary model selection as '<provider>/<model-id>' (e.g., 'openai/gpt-5.5', 'ollama/llama3.1:8b', 'qwen-cloud/qwen3.7-plus'). The provider part is split on the first '/'; model ids may contain further slashes (e.g., 'huggingface/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B'). Legacy key 'model' is also accepted.

provider.description: Provider label (redundant with defaultModel, kept for readability).

baseURL.description: Override base URL for the active provider. Legacy key 'base_url' is also accepted.

useResponsesEndpoint.description: Use the OpenAI Responses API instead of Chat Completions. Legacy key 'use_responses_endpoint' is also accepted.

enableThinking.description: Enable extended thinking / reasoning mode. Legacy key 'enable_thinking' is also accepted.

systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt override. Legacy key 'system_prompt' is also accepted.

bashClassifierUrl.description: URL of the local bash command safety classifier endpoint. Legacy key 'bash_classifier_url' is also accepted.

providers.description: Per-provider configuration keyed by provider name. Accepts builtin labels ('openai', 'ollama', 'openrouter', ...) and custom provider names ('qwen-cloud', 'my-endpoint'). Custom providers appear in the /connect picker and use the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

mcpServers.description: Model Context Protocol server integrations. Legacy keys 'mcp_servers' and 'mcp' are also accepted.

context.description: Context window management and automatic compaction policy.

baseURL.description: Custom base URL for this provider. Legacy key 'base_url' is also accepted.

models.description: Per-model configuration keyed by model id.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level for this model. 'default' sends no reasoning parameter (model decides); 'none' disables thinking explicitly.

contextWindow.description: Context window size in tokens for this model. Overrides the catalogue lookup. Falls back to context.overrideContextWindow when unset.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens per generation turn for this model. Sent as max_tokens in the request body. Falls back to context.maxOutputTokens when unset.

reasoningOptions.description: Reasoning efforts this model supports. The TUI model picker filters its reasoning cycle to this list. Empty or absent means all efforts are available.

overrideContextWindow.description: Explicit context window size in tokens. Overrides the model catalogue lookup (useful for local Ollama/LMStudio models).

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens per single model generation turn.

CompactionSettings.description: Automatic context summarization policy when approaching the model context window limit.

auto.description: Enable automatic context compaction before reaching limits.

threshold.description: Fraction of context window (0.1–1.0) that triggers background summarization. The swap watermark is derived as threshold + 0.20 (capped at 0.95).

bufferTokens.description: Reserve token buffer for compaction preflight checks.

keepRecentTokens.description: Recent conversation tokens retained verbatim alongside the generated summary. Scaled down proportionally for small-context models.
